title: What is the average amount of credit card withdrawals made in 1998 by clien
question: What is the average amount of credit card withdrawals made in 1998 by clients who are not account owners and live in districts where the average salary is between $8000 and $9000?

prediction.sql:
SELECT AVG(T4."XCL_051")
FROM card AS T1
INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1."XCL_006" = T2."XCL_013"
INNER JOIN account AS T3 ON T2."XCL_015" = T3."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN trans AS T4 ON T3."XCL_001" = T4."XCL_047"
INNER JOIN district AS T5 ON T3."XCL_002" = T5."XCL_017"
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T4."XCL_048") = '1998'
  AND T4."XCL_050" = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND T2."XCL_016" <> 'OWNER'
  AND T5."XCL_027" BETWEEN 8000 AND 9000

District scope: district.XCL_027 BETWEEN 8000 AND 9000 is supported by the historical district-range program and observed XCL_027 values in the 8000-12000 range; XCL_028/XCL_029 are small rates and do not fit the 8000-9000 salary-like range.

Grain: each qualifying card-disposition-account-transaction row is one withdrawal observation; no repeated trans.XCL_046 key was observed in the pre-aggregate input, so AVG is not inflated by an extra one-to-many join.

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT AVG(T4."XCL_051")
FROM card AS T1
INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1."XCL_006" = T2."XCL_013"
INNER JOIN account AS T3 ON T2."XCL_015" = T3."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN trans AS T4 ON T3."XCL_001" = T4."XCL_047"
INNER JOIN district AS T5 ON T3."XCL_002" = T5."XCL_017"
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T4."XCL_048") = '1998'
  AND T4."XCL_050" = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND T2."XCL_016" <> 'OWNER'
  AND T5."XCL_027" BETWEEN 8000 AND 9000

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT AVG(t.XCL_055) AS average_withdrawal
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.XCL_047 = a.XCL_001
JOIN disp d ON a.XCL_001 = d.XCL_015
JOIN client c ON d.XCL_014 = c.XCL_009
JOIN district dist ON c.XCL_012 = dist.XCL_017
WHERE t.XCL_053 = 'withdrawal'
  AND t.XCL_049 = 'card'
  AND d.XCL_016 = 'not owner'
  AND dist.XCL_028 BETWEEN 8000 AND 9000
  AND strftime('%Y', t.XCL_048) = '1998'
